resources.title: Tool Schema & Output Self-Review Checklist
resources.description: A compiled, reusable checklist from Chapter 2: the description quality test with the real good-vs-poor stock-price example, the four-question self-review, consolidation/namespacing/high-signal practices, a routing decision tree for growing tool counts, and output-formatting and error-message rules. Run every tool through this before shipping it.

resources.title: Approval Request & Audit Log Entry Templates
resources.description: A real JSON template for the two record shapes Chapter 5 builds around: a pending approval request and an audit log entry, with both an approved and a rejected example filled in, plus field-by-field notes explaining why each field exists (reviewer context, is_error semantics, append-only discipline).

resources.title: Agent Guardrail Config Template
resources.description: A YAML config template combining Chapter 6's three stopping conditions, the cost and action-scope budgets, sandbox network/filesystem/credential scoping, and the four monitoring signals to track — structured as code-level config, not a prompt instruction, matching the lesson's guidance that guardrails belong around the loop.

resources.title: Refund Agent Reference Build (Annotated)
resources.description: The capstone's three-lesson build (schemas, approval, logging, limits, deployment checklist) consolidated into one annotated reference file, the way you'd actually keep it in a real project instead of split across lessons.
